_doc: New M1 UI/systems lines (bs.* ids), same shape as lines_index.json. BSText reads these after lines_index. bs.ui.shop.desc.lawn_dart and bs.ui.shop.browse are the original shopStock / shopShowDesc text (index.html:11964, 12189) that the extractor missed.

bs.ui.shop.desc.lawn_dart.text: A slow, patient, homing lawn dart. Banned in 38 star systems; classified as "a lawn game" in the other 4. Some assembly required. Assembly sold separately.

bs.ui.shop.browse.text: Browse away! Blartz accepts bolts and flattery. Mostly bolts.

bs.ui.shop.coming_soon_desc.text: Blartz is still "finishing" this one. It is on back-order from a warehouse that may not exist.

bs.ui.shop.style_closed.text: The paint booth is closed for fumigation. Style returns in a later shipment.

bs.ui.shop.locked_patent.text: Only Blartz understands this thing. Rescue him first.

bs.ui.menu.bs_missing.text: Scrapheap Junction is still being welded together.
